card.text: Rapidly rotating A-type star 7.68 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Vega is a rapidly rotating A-type star 7.68 parsecs away, wider at its equator than at its poles. It is drawn that shape, pole toward us.

sources.label: Monnier et al. 2012

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Measured colour, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
